questions.proof: Tokyo is the capital of Japan and its biggest city.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Japan?

questions.proof: Honshu, which means 'Mainland' in the Japanese language, is the biggest island.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “It invaded and annexed Ryukyu Kingdom, _____, and Korea.”

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The Second Sino-Japanese War (1937-1945) grew to become a part of World War II when Japan became allies with Nazi _____ and Fascist Italy.”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter G and has 7 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “History” part of the Japan article.
